label: Agent & MCP: every word

params.name: lede
params.default: Let Claude Code on your laptop drive {product} for tests and demos: the same buttons you press, with your owner key. Sign-ins and payments stay with people.
params.label: lede

params.name: art_door_sub
params.default: checks the key on every call
params.label: art door sub

params.name: art_human_sub
params.default: Signing in, accepting permissions and payments - the tool says which step is next
params.label: art human sub

params.name: key_none
params.default: No key yet. Make one, then paste one line on your laptop.
params.label: key none

params.name: del_msg
params.default: Claude Code on your laptop stops reaching {product} at once. You can make a new key any time.
params.label: del msg

params.name: remake_msg
params.default: The key you have now stops working at once. You paste the new line on your laptop.
params.label: remake msg

params.name: made_lede
params.default: Copy this line and paste it in a terminal on your laptop. It adds {product} to Claude Code with your key. The key is not shown again: {product} keeps only its fingerprint.
params.label: made lede

params.name: made_warn
params.default: Never paste this line in a chat, an email or a shared file. Anyone with it can press your buttons.
params.label: made warn

params.name: step1
params.default: Make your key here. It is shown once.
params.label: step1

params.name: step2
params.default: Paste the line in a terminal on your laptop, where Claude Code is installed.
params.label: step2

params.name: cmd_label
params.default: The line - your key goes where it says {key_here}
params.label: cmd label

params.name: tools_lede
params.default: Each tool is one of {product}'s own buttons, checked as you. Search finds a word even when misspelt.
params.label: tools lede

params.name: e_key
params.default: This owner key does not work. Make a new one on Admin > Agent & MCP.
params.label: e key

params.name: e_not_tool
params.default: Claude may use only the tools on Admin > Agent & MCP, and this is not one of them.
params.label: e not tool

params.name: e_human
params.default: {title}: a person does this, never Claude. {say}
params.label: e human

params.name: e_rate
params.default: Too many calls in one minute. Wait a moment, then try again.
params.label: e rate

params.name: c_instructions
params.default: Drives {product} for tests and demos with the portal owner's key, through {product}'s own buttons. Signing in, passwords, accepting permissions and payments are never done by a tool: the tool for that step says what the person does.
params.label: c instructions

params.name: c_no_url
params.default: {product} has no address here. Add -e {env_url}=https://your-portal to the claude mcp add line.
params.label: c no url

params.name: c_bad_url
params.default: {url} is not a safe address for your key. Use https - plain http only for this computer.
params.label: c bad url

params.name: c_no_key
params.default: There is no owner key here. Make one on Admin > Agent & MCP and add it with -e {env_key}=...
params.label: c no key

params.name: c_unreachable
params.default: {product} did not answer ({why}). Check the address and that the portal is running.
params.label: c unreachable

params.name: c_human
params.default: A person does this, not Claude - {title}. {say}
params.label: c human

params.name: c_cut
params.default: ... (cut here: the answer was longer than {n} characters)
params.label: c cut
